experiment: QM9S full MTO-UV-T architecture, spectrum-only supervision, v1 20260914
loss: MSE(predicted_source_spectrum / train_RMS, source_spectrum / train_RMS); no E, A, f or rank loss
selection_rule: Full architecture frozen before opening new test predictions. Per-scale checkpoint uses validation spectrum MSE only. No later scale retuning on earlier test results.
sigma_scope: Fixed Gaussian standard deviation 0.2 eV from plan, not a claim about source CSV generation. Source width and absolute oscillator units may differ; exported state factors are latent under spectrum-only supervision.
baseline: DetaNet invariant sum pooling with matched active parameter count, same E/A/f/Gaussian physics decoder and train-only RMS. No MTO assembly or reference CG.
uncertainty: Paired seed statistics and molecule bootstrap conditional on fixed fitted models; historical 1k/10k tests have already been viewed for previous architecture.
budget: Same max epochs, batch, optimizer and early stopping in each pair; measured time, steps and memory. No equal-FLOP claim.
